name: Blessing of Strength
Description: Temporarily imbues your muscles with divine power, allowing devastating melee strikes.

name: Blessing of Fury
Description: Channels primal rage into your attacks, making you faster but more vulnerable.

name: Blessing of the Warrior
Description: A warrior's blessing that enhances all aspects of combat proficiency.

name: Blessing of Critical Strike
Description: Sharpens your senses and precision for devastating critical attacks.

name: Blessing of Armor
Description: Reinforces your armor with divine metal, increasing its protective qualities.

name: Blessing of Battle
Description: A balanced combat blessing that enhances multiple fighting aspects simultaneously.

name: Blessing of the Berserker
Description: When near death, your attacks become increasingly powerful in a frenzy of rage.

name: Blessing of Precision
Description: Guides your projectiles with divine accuracy, perfect for archers and marksmen.

name: Blessing of Endurance
Description: Grants tireless endurance, allowing prolonged combat without fatigue.

name: Blessing of Devastation
Description: Concentrates all divine power into one apocalyptic strike.

name: Blessing of the Gladiator
Effect: +15% damage in arena combat, +10% dodge chance
Description: Channel the spirit of legendary gladiators for superior arena performance.

name: Blessing of Bloodlust
Description: Siphons life force from enemies with each successful attack.

name: Blessing of the Titan
Description: Grows your form to titan proportions with immense strength but reduced agility.

name: Blessing of Unyielding
Effect: Cannot be killed by single hit (survives with 1 HP)
Description: Grants divine protection from instant death once per blessing duration.

name: Blessing of the Warlord
Effect: +20% damage to all allies, +10% damage reduction for party
Description: A commander's blessing that enhances entire party's combat effectiveness.

name: Blessing of Healing
Description: Channels gentle light to mend wounds over time.

name: Blessing of Purification
Description: Cleanses body and soul of poisons, curses, and ailments.

name: Blessing of Restoration
Description: A surge of healing energy that restores a significant portion of health.

name: Blessing of Vitality
Description: Accelerates natural healing processes for sustained recovery.

name: Blessing of the Healer
Description: Enhances your ability to heal allies, perfect for support classes.

name: Blessing of Rejuvenation
Effect: Restore 1% health per second for 30 seconds
Description: Rapid healing that can turn the tide of battle in critical moments.

name: Blessing of the Phoenix
Description: Grants a single resurrection with significant health restoration.

name: Blessing of Immunity
Effect: Immune to poison, disease, and bleed effects
Description: Creates a protective barrier against biological and chemical attacks.

name: Blessing of Mending
Effect: Repairs all equipment durability to maximum
Description: Divinely restores all equipped items to perfect condition.

name: Blessing of the Lifebringer
Effect: Create healing zone that heals all allies for 2% health per second
Description: Establishes a sacred ground where allies continuously regenerate health.

name: Blessing of Eternal Youth
Description: Grants eternal youth, preventing age-related penalties and enhancing vitality.

name: Blessing of Mana
Description: Accelerates mana recovery for sustained spellcasting.

name: Blessing of Wisdom
Description: Enhances magical abilities through divine wisdom.

name: Blessing of Spellpower
Description: Drastically increases the potency of offensive spells.

name: Blessing of Concentration
Description: Sharpens mental focus to maintain spellcasting under pressure.

name: Blessing of the Archmage
Description: A comprehensive magic blessing from the highest magical authorities.

name: Blessing of Elemental Affinity
Description: Aligns your magic with a specific element for increased power.

name: Blessing of Mana Shield
Description: Creates a magical barrier that uses mana to absorb damage.

name: Blessing of Spell Echo
Description: Gives spells a chance to repeat automatically for double impact.

name: Blessing of the Void
Description: Embraces void energy for powerful dark magic at the cost of vulnerability.

name: Blessing of Infinite Knowledge
Effect: Learn any spell instantly, +10% spell variety
Description: Grants immediate mastery of any spell you attempt to learn.

name: Blessing of Magical Resonance
Effect: Spells chain to nearby enemies for 50% damage
Description: Your spells vibrate through enemies, affecting multiple targets.

name: Blessing of Warding
Description: Creates a protective ward against magical attacks.

name: Blessing of Shield
Description: Manifests a divine shield that blocks a fixed amount of damage.

name: Blessing of Invulnerability
Effect: Immune to all damage for 10 seconds
Description: Grants temporary complete immunity to all forms of damage.

name: Blessing of Deflection
Description: Creates a reflective barrier that bounces magical attacks.

name: Blessing of the Turtle
Description: Trades mobility for incredible damage resistance.

name: Blessing of Sanctuary
Effect: Create safe zone, allies inside cannot be targeted
Description: Establishes a sacred area where allies are protected from direct attacks.

name: Blessing of Fortification
Description: Transforms your body into a living fortress of divine protection.

name: Blessing of Reflection
Effect: 50% of damage taken reflected to attacker
Description: Creates a perfect mirror that reflects half of all damage received.

name: Blessing of the Unbreakable
Effect: Cannot be stunned, feared, or silenced
Description: Grants absolute mental and physical resilience against crowd control.

name: Blessing of Aegis
Effect: +30% all defenses, regenerate 2% health per second while stationary
Description: Bestows the legendary Aegis shield with enhanced protective capabilities.

name: Blessing of the Eternal Guard
Effect: Permanent +10% damage reduction (stacks up to 3 times)
Description: A permanent blessing that continuously strengthens your defenses.

name: Blessing of Fortune
Description: Attracts luck and fortune, improving loot and gold acquisition.

name: Blessing of Charm
Description: Enhances your social presence and charm for better interactions.

name: Blessing of Speed
Description: Grants incredible swiftness for rapid travel or escape.

name: Blessing of the Explorer
Description: Opens secret routes and enhances discovery rewards.

name: Blessing of the Scholar
Description: Accelerates learning and experience acquisition.

name: Blessing of Stealth
Description: Grants enhanced stealth capabilities for infiltration and ambush.

name: Blessing of the Merchant
Description: Improves your bargaining skills for better trade deals.

name: Blessing of the Smith
Description: Enhances crafting abilities for better equipment creation.

name: Blessing of Night Vision
Effect: See perfectly in darkness, +15% night stealth
Description: Grants perfect vision in dark environments.

name: Blessing of the Beast
Effect: Transform into animal form for 30 minutes
Description: Allows transformation into various animal forms for unique abilities.

name: Blessing of the Shadow
Effect: Become invisible for 10 seconds, +25% backstab damage
Description: Grants temporary invisibility with enhanced stealth attack damage.

name: Blessing of Time
Effect: Slow time for 5 seconds (enemies move at 25% speed)
Description: Manipulates time flow to gain tactical advantage in combat.

name: Blessing of the Chameleon
Description: Temporarily gains the ability of your most recent opponent.

name: Blessing of the Gambler
Description: Takes a chance with random outcomes ranging from divine favor to misfortune.

name: Blessing of the Ancient
Description: Channels the power of ancient beings for comprehensive enhancement.
